name: public-hero
js: const e = document.querySelector('.own-hero__media img'); e.style.outline = '8px solid #B4502A'; e.style.outlineOffset = '6px';

name: admin-website-hero
js: for (const s of ['[aria-label="Edit Hero"]']) { const e = document.querySelector(s); e.style.outline = '5px solid #B4502A'; e.style.outlineOffset = '4px'; e.closest('li').style.boxShadow = '0 0 0 4px #B4502A'; }

name: editor-photo
js: const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('.photo-field__current button')][0]; b.style.outline = '5px solid #B4502A'; b.style.outlineOffset = '4px';

name: picker-garden
js: const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('.photo-option')].find((e) => e.textContent.includes('garden')); b.style.outline = '6px solid #B4502A'; b.style.outlineOffset = '3px';

name: editor-picked
js: const t = document.querySelector('.photo-field__thumb'); t.src = t.src.replace('hero.svg', 'garden.svg'); document.querySelector('.photo-field__name').textContent = 'Current photo: garden.svg'; const a = document.querySelector('#hero-photo-alt-field'); a.value = ''; a.textContent = ''; a.style.outline = '5px solid #B4502A'; a.style.outlineOffset = '2px';

name: picker-upload
js: const e = document.querySelector('.photo-upload'); e.style.outline = '6px solid #B4502A'; e.style.outlineOffset = '6px'; e.style.borderRadius = '8px';

name: editor-described
js: const t = document.querySelector('.photo-field__thumb'); t.src = t.src.replace('hero.svg', 'garden.svg'); document.querySelector('.photo-field__name').textContent = 'Current photo: garden.svg'; const a = document.querySelector('#hero-photo-alt-field'); a.value = 'A woman in a sun hat waters the flowers in our rooftop garden, with the city behind her.'; const s = document.querySelector('.content-dialog__footer .btn-primary'); s.style.outline = '5px solid #B4502A'; s.style.outlineOffset = '4px';

name: public-hero-after
js: const e = document.querySelector('.own-hero__media img'); e.src = e.src.replace('hero.svg', 'garden.svg'); e.alt = 'A woman in a sun hat waters the flowers in our rooftop garden, with the city behind her.';

name: admin-website-photos
js: for (const s of ['[aria-label="Edit A look around"]', '[aria-label="Edit Our building and community"]', '[aria-label="Edit A word from a member"]']) { document.querySelector(s).closest('li').style.boxShadow = '0 0 0 4px #B4502A'; }
